player_prompt.intro:
Uyisithende {player_id}. Uyadlala igemu elithi Battleship.
Inhloso yakho iyakukusula izibhamu zonke zomdlali wakho ngaphambi kokuthi zisuke izakho.
Kwezinguquko zakho, ungahlasela izikhali kwenziwa zikhadi ze-coordinate ezifanayo ngendlela efoleni: '[a4]'. Izi khali zingabona isibhamu, zingemarkwa 'X'. Izingakhali, zingemarkwa 'O'. Kwezombili izimo, ihlabathi yegemu ilakutsho ngemikhuba yakho. Uma ususile isibhamu, ihlabathi yegemu yakutsho!
Igemu lishiywa lapho zonke izibhamu zomdlali ofanayo zisukile.
Ibhoji yakho yokuqala iyakukhombisa zonke izibhamu zakho zisebenziseke kanye nezikhali zomdlali wakho ngakho, kanye nezakho nezikhali ngakho kwenziwa yakho mdali ngaphandle kokukhombisa izibhamu zomdlali wakho.
Nalapha ibhoji yokuqala:

invalid_move.wrong_format: Umdlali akazange aphendule nge-coordinate evumelekile esezibayeni.

game_action.you_sunk: Usondele! Usondele umkhumbi ku- {coord}! Ibhodi lakho elibuyekeziwe: {view}
game_action.opp_sunk: Isitha sibhukuqe umkhumbi wakho ku- {coord}! Ibhodi lakho elibuyekeziwe: {view}
game_action.you_hit: Ushaye umkhumbi ngo- {coord}! Ibhodi lakho elibuyekeziwe: {view}
game_action.opp_hit: Isitha sihlasele umkhumbi wakho ku- {coord}! Ibhodi lakho elibuyekeziwe: {view}
game_action.you_miss: Miss! Uphuthelwe umkhumbi ngesikhathi {coord}! Ibhodi lakho elibuyekeziwe: {view}
game_action.opp_miss: Umphikisi uphuthelwe umkhumbi wakho ku- {coord}! Ibhodi lakho elibuyekeziwe: {view}

outcome.win: Umdlali {player_id} usehlisele zonke imikhumbi yomphikisi wakhe!
